description: List practices for adopting AI that fit a company's size, rated by strength of evidence. Use it for 'Where should we start with AI?' or 'What should a 120-person manufacturer do first?'. Pass the number of employees or a size band, and optionally the theme, stage or priority. Returns the practices in one line each, or a menu by theme when there are many; fetch the ones you use with get_evidence for their studies, cases and links.

size.description: Company size band: micro-small, medium, mid-market, enterprise (1–49, 50–249, 250–999, 1,000+ employees). Or pass employees instead.

stage.description: How far the company is: explore, adopt, redesign or run.

theme.description: A theme key from start, e.g. governance-and-risk or people-and-skills.

name: find_practices
title: Find rated practices for adopting AI
